---
title: "Box Office Numbers"
---

This site looks at 104 popular films released from 1980 to 2025. Each row in `films.csv` records the title, year, franchise, budget, worldwide revenue, runtime, and IMDb rating.

Analysis pages:

- [Budget and Revenue](budget-revenue.qmd)
- [Runtime and Ratings](runtime-rating.qmd)
- [The Bond Films](bond.qmd)

I used a AI assistant (ChatGPT) to help me debug my GitHub push issue (permission denied). I also referenced the lecture slides and the Quarto website documentation for assistance.
